task_intent.title: Add Individual File Discard in Human Review
task_intent.description:
Add selective file discard functionality to the human review workflow, enabling users to exclude unwanted files (e.g., CSS changes) from task changes before merging/staging. This feature extends the existing DiffViewDialog with per-file discard actions that use `git restore` to revert specific files in the worktree without affecting other changes.
